reviews.text: Wow such a responsible and supportive place. Highly recommend
A very well-stocked shop not only with food, but also with toys and various furnishings for every need of our animal friends.

I frequent the Vomero store, and it's a go-to place for me. The shop is well-stocked, and everyone who works there is incredibly kind and always ready to offer advice and help. I couldn't live without them.
